Subject: Amendment to the Transfer Policy of Commissioners' Cadre, 2022 — reg
Ma’am/Sir,

Please refer to the Transfer Policy of Commissioners' Cadre 2022 (TP-CC) and Amendment
to the Transfer Policy of Commissioners' Cadre, 2022 circulated vide circular of even number dated
30.03.2022 (Web circular no: 304 of 2021-22) and 30.05.2022 (Web circular no: 69 of 2022-23)
respectively.

Chairman, CBT the following amendment is notified as under:-

Para Existing Provision Revised provision
5.18(iv) | Transfers on promotion shall be | Transfers on promotion shall be made by the
made by Central PF | Competent Authority as defined in Para 3 as amended

in the public domain and thus notified for information of all.

Yours faithfully,
